en:
This is our final battle. I need to make sure
they can pass on in peace!

The old man said the ghosts would be gone for good.
Maybe I should stop by the cemetery at night
again, just to make sure.

I've been asked to take on the role of Ono Michio,
a local mascot. I wanted to decline, but I'd rather
not disappoint all the children who love him.

Ono Michio can't let some thugs get away with
making these kids cry.

Hironaka asked me to take on the role of Ono Michio
again. What should I do...?

One of the Ono Michio fans seems really depressed.
Maybe I should go try to talk to her.

Ono Michio might be able to help Shizuko out.
I should go meet Hironaka in front of Yonetoku.

These punks never learn. Watch how courageous
your treasured Ono Michio can be, Shizuko!

This story sounds too bizarre to be made up.
I should talk to the girl in question a bit more.

This girl talks about some strange stuff, but she still
seems like a good person. I should talk to her again
if I ever see her around.

It must be pretty traumatic watching your father bow
to some lowlife punks. Time to change the future.

Miku should be doing better now. I need to make sure
I live the one life I have to the absolute fullest.

I've never heard of people actually swapping bodies...
Maybe I should talk to those two if I see them again.

What kind of degenerates gang up on a "woman"?
Time to teach these punks a lesson.

Hatakeyama-san seems a little depressed.
I should head to New Gaudi and talk to him.

Hatakeyama-san's daughter is apparently going to
La Pente on a date. I'm worried he's going to get
caught following her...

It sounds like Hatakeyama-san's relationship with
his daughter has improved. I wonder if he's over at
New Gaudi today.

Akiyoshi-san apparently needs to talk to me about
something. I should go to New Gaudi and hear what
he has to say.

Akiyoshi-san forgot his wallet at the bar when he
went home. I need to go return it to him.

I wonder if Akiyoshi-san managed to talk to his teacher
at his reunion. I should ask him about it next time I'm
over at New Gaudi.

I just saw Gen-san walking into New Gaudi.
Maybe I should head inside, too.

I'm glad Gen-san is a little less wary of technology now.
I wonder if he's gotten around to buying a smartphone.

It looks like Gen-san is really enjoying his new phone.
I should go check on him over at New Gaudi.

Gen-san is probably even better with technology now.
I should stop by New Gaudi again and check on him.

Ando-san is busy looking at something a random
customer of his brought in. Life working in a pawn shop
must be tough.

Ando-san seemed to be acting strange after he took
a look at that ring. I should ask him about it over at
New Gaudi later.

I should go check on Ando-san at the pawn shop.
Hopefully he's feeling better...

Who would've thought the thief would come here of
his own volition? Anyway, I need to get that bag back.

The old lady said she saw Ando-san down by the
shoreline. I should go look for him there.

I wonder how things have been going between
Ando-san and his wife. Maybe I should head over
to New Gaudi and ask him about it.

Kaneko-san's waiting for me at New Gaudi.
I should head over there if I have the time.

So Kaneko-san's boxing career was stolen away from
him... I should go tell him the truth.

I'm glad Kaneko-san managed to break free from his
past. New Gaudi should be a little livelier now.

Weird... I actually feel pretty connected to the gang
over at New Gaudi. I should stop by when I have time.

I wrote a letter telling Mama how thankful I am for
everything. Now the question is, where to hide it...?

I wonder if Mama's noticed the letter yet.
Guess I'll just kill some time for a bit.

It's almost time for my meeting with Mama.
I should head down to the dock.

I didn't think my letter would end up in the wrong
hands... Oh well, guess I'll just have to try again.

I hope Mama noticed the letter this time.
Guess I'll just wait around for a little while.

I finally managed to show how thankful I am of Mama.
Time to head back to New Gaudi for now.

I've really had a great time at New Gaudi recently.
I should drop by if I ever start missing it.

Isao-san says he'll take me spearfishing.
I should go see him when I have some time.

Looks like I'll be taking Isao-san's place in the
spearfishing scene. I should go talk to him when
I'm ready to fish.

The most delicious octopus in the world... I'll get
another player for my baseball team if I can defeat it,
so I should try my absolute hardest.

So my opponent this time is the man-eating
Bloody Shark... I'll avenge your father, Amano.

Some guy named Saigo challenged me to a fight.
Let's see what he's made of.

That Saigo guy challenged me to another fight.
I can't afford to hold back this time.

Hatakeyama-san introduced me to the people over at
New Gaudi. It might be fun to drop in and have
a few drinks with them every so often.

(Chapter 11)
I need to tell Nagumo and the others
what's going on before I head up to Kamurocho.

(Chapter 1)
Let's see if there's any more info near Sky Finance...

Someone's going to fall off the roof
of the arcade. I need to help them!

I don't get it<symbol=em_dash_with_outline>why's he so keen on fighting?
Might as well give him what he wants, though.

(Chapter 4)
I'm ready to sleep for the night.

(Chapter 4)
I might want to drop by Moreno.

(Chapter 4)
Kiyomi's bringing Haruto back to the apartment.
I shouldn't keep her waiting.

Someone's going to fall off the roof of the
batting center. I need to help them!

(Chapter 6)
I should use this time to get ready for Kamurocho,
then head back to the apartment.

(Chapter 6)
We might be able to get some information
on Tatsukawa over at Stardust.

(Chapter 7)
I need to find Akiyama, no matter what.
Maybe I should check in the sewer from before.

(Chapter 7)
Time for my meeting with Akiyama.
He's waiting at the APA Hotel in Theater Square.

(Chapter 7)
No one's following me anymore. Now to go meet
up with Akiyama.

(Chapter 7)
I should head back to New Serena and
get in touch with Nagumo and Yuta.

(Chapter 7)
I'm being followed... I'll have to lead my pursuers
into an alleyway and find out who's behind this.

(Chapter 7)
Akiyama and I are sneaking up to the roof together.
Let's try to make sure nobody sees us in here.

(Chapter 8)
I should make sure I'm ready to head to Shangri-La
with Someya, then go talk to Akiyama.

(Chapter 9)
We need to hurry back to Hiroshima as fast as possible.
I should talk to Nagumo when I'm ready.

(Chapter 9)
Maybe the members of the Hirose Family
would know where Hirose-san might be...

(Chapter 9)
Is there any way up to the second floor?

(Chapter 10)
I hope they can hold the Yomei Alliance off.
For now though, I should go wait at the Hirose Family Office.

(Chapter 9)
Why would Hirose-san kidnap Haruto?
Maybe there's a lead in his room.

(Finale)
This is probably going to be my last night in Kamurocho.
I should talk to Nagumo when I'm ready...

(I should talk to the RIZAP trainer
if I feel like starting a membership.)

(Chapter 11)
I should get ready to head up to Kamurocho,
then talk to Yuta when I'm finished.

There's apparently a pickpocket on the loose.
I'm going to put a stop to it, now.

Paul Lim, a living darts legend, challenged me
to a match. I wonder if I'd be able to beat him...

It's finally time to face the Kanamizawa Gorgeous.
Chiba's waiting for me up at the baseball field.

The Kanamizawa Gorgeous won't be so pretty once we're
done with them. I should talk to Chiba when I'm ready.

I guess the Kanamizawa Gorgeous won't go down so easily.
We won't back down, though! Let's do this, Warriors!
I guess our camraderie prevailed in the end.

I need to deliver this ramen so the injured
employee doesn't get roughed up by his client.
Time to clean up the streets.

I keep hearing someone calling for help on Tenkaichi
Street. Pretty sure it's coming from higher up...

The legendary Paul Lim...
I should play him again if I have some time.

Sounds like there's a small fire in Kamurocho.
I should find a fire extinguisher and put it out.

Another small fire in Kamurocho.
I should find a fire extinguisher and put it out.

Yet another small fire in Kamurocho.
I should find a fire extinguisher and put it out.

Sounds like a building in Kamurocho is up in flames.
I should find a fire extinguisher and put it out.

Sounds like there's a small fire in Onomichi.
I should find a fire extinguisher and put it out.

Another small fire in Onomichi.
I should find a fire extinguisher and put it out.

Yet another small fire in Onomichi.
I should find a fire extinguisher and put it out.

Sounds like a car in Onomichi is up in flames.
I should find a fire extinguisher and put it out.

It's time to show these punks
what real chivalry looks like.

(Chapter 12)
I should get ready to head back to Onomichi,
then take a taxi over to the train station.

It sounded like the cat café manager was arguing with
a customer. Did he say he doesn't have any cats...?

I saw a Troublr post about a bomb in Kamurocho.
I need to find it before it goes off.
I know the bomber is at an internet café, but which one?

(Chapter 12)
Lo's finally awake. Let's hear the rest of what
he started telling us back in Little Asia.

(Chapter 4)
I should probably apologize to Matsunaga
for what happened last night.
Now that I'm a RIZAP member, I should start training.

I'm supposed to eat something after training.
I should report back to my trainer once I do.

(Chapter 7)
Akiyama's going to call me soon. I guess I'll just have to
walk around Kamurocho until he does.

(Chapter 5)
Someya has to know where Kiyomi is.

(Chapter 7)
Dammit, we should've seen an ambush coming.

(Chapter 7)
I'll have to head down to the second floor alone...

(Chapter 12)
We need to break through these guys and find the secret!

Wow, this girl is really something else.
I should use this photo to try and find her.

(Chapter 7)
I hope Akiyama's plan works...

(Chapter 9)
I need to look into Hirose-san's frequent hangout spots.

(Chapter 11)
I need to find Yuta before this building burns to the ground.
I'm supposed to meet Erina in Theater Square.
